page.layout: One printed page (right-hand page of the opening). Main text in one column, left of centre, with quotation marks printed in a narrow column on its right edge. Running head across the top, page number at top right. Signature and catchword below the last line.

main_text.p: generibus, particulariùs Nyssenus ; ubi memorat [antequàm veniretur ad periculum, martyribus metum incus-sisse tortores, oftensis cruentibus, & igni-bus, bestijs, & instrumentis ad tor-quendum membra accommodatis; erant & ferreę in igne cathedrę, & lig-na erecta, qui eorum extensa qui per-sistebant corpora porrectis horren-dis laniabant unguli s, aliaque innu-merabilia ad multiplices corporum cruciatus ab eis excogitabantur; u-numque studium erat eis, qui hanc habebant potestatem, ut nullus in eo possetostendi scelere superior. Alij quidem deferebant, alij vero iudica-bant, alij vero scrutabantur eos, qui erant absconsi, alij inuadebant eos, qui fugiebant, alij autem injectis ocu-lis infacultates fidelium, ut rebus co-rum potirentur, prætextu pietatis & religionis, eos qui fidem amplecte-bantur exagitabant,] Hactenùs[?] Nyssenus. Verùm dum hæc moliebatur Imperator, quid interim meditatur Fa-bianus Romanus Pontifex, aut reliquus Romanæ Ecclesiæ Clerus ? Cur non

page.notes: Right-hand narrow column holds only a printed quotation mark („) beside each line of the bracketed passage; no marginal text, so no notes transcribed. Text in the bracket is a quotation from Nyssenus; "Hactenùs" is set with a ligature and is doubtful. Spelling "possetostendi" and "scelere" as printed (the scan shows "poffetoftendi"; the line break may be "possetostendi" with a missing space, left as read). Left edge shows part of the facing page, ignored. Long s rendered as plain s throughout, as instructed.
